subject: Payment swingline and tiered credit thresholds for Aurelia
messages:
From: Marcus Hale <marcus@aureliahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia AP <ap@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment terms request for pilot — Aurelia / Redwood

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move to a 3‑month pilot. Finance ran a quick read on our cash flow and has asked if Redwood can accommodate Net60 for the pilot period (we can commit to a PO). Two quick notes from our side:

- We need an invoice cadence that aligns with our month‑end so we don't create extra accruals (ideally invoices on the 1st of each month, billed monthly).
- VAT: Aurelia is VAT registered in the EU but the pilot will be run from our US entity; we will need Redwood to provide VAT invoices / evidence if requested by our tax team.

Attached is a short SOW v2 with estimated consumption. Can Redwood provide a proposed schedule and any credit guardrails if you can stretch to Net60?

—Marcus
Head of Partnerships
Aurelia Health
[attachment: Aurelia_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for pilot — Aurelia / Redwood

Marcus — great to hear the pilot is moving forward. We're open to structuring something to help with your cash conversion, but want to balance Redwood's exposure. Proposed option below (we can iterate):

1) Pilot term: 3 months, invoiced monthly on the 1st (matching your request).
2) Terms: Net45 standard, with a conditional Net60 swingline for amounts up to a $75k credit corridor during the pilot. The swingline is a short-term bridge that Redwood will provide for up to 30 days past Net45 for eligible invoices.
3) Credit corridor & thresholds: initial credit ceiling $75k. If cumulative spend in month 2 exceeds 60% of the projected SOW, we auto‑increase the corridor to $150k after an interim credit check (simple balance‑sheet confirmation + current PO).
4) Deposit: no deposit for the pilot if the PO is issued and AP email is verified; otherwise we ask for a 10% refundable deposit.
5) VAT: Redwood will issue invoices showing US sales; if you require EU VAT evidence (reverse charge or proof of export), please provide the VAT registration and we will attach the required documentation. Any VAT liability remains the customer's responsibility; Redwood will help produce supporting docs.

Attachments: I pulled together a short credit workbook that models the corridor and timing so you can see when the swingline would trigger. Also included our standard invoice template and a draft clause for inclusion in the SOW.

If this looks okay in principle, I'll loop in Sales Ops and Legal to draft the one‑page addendum and a DocuSign link. Can you confirm the AP contact and PO timeline?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
[kimberly@redwood.com]
[attachment: Redwood-credit-workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for pilot — Aurelia / Redwood

Couple of operational notes / risk controls to consider before we finalize the corridor:

- Add a consumption cap clause tied to the SOW (e.g., if actual usage > 130% of SOW estimate, we require an interim reconcile and either a deposit or reverting to Net30).
- Require AP verification: an email from ap@aureliahealth.com with PO number and billing contact before enabling swingline. No swingline without that verification.
- VAT: include a standard clause that if VAT is later assessed to Redwood due to incorrect customer guidance, Aurelia will reimburse any assessed tax + interest.

I'll draft suggested language for the addendum; if Kimberly wants I can also run a quick credit check (public filings + bank reference) on Aurelia to sign off on $150k corridor.

—Vivek

From: Marcus Hale <marcus@aureliahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia AP <ap@aureliahealth.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for pilot — Aurelia / Redwood

Kimberly / Vivek — appreciate the clear proposal. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can confirm AP contact: ap@aureliahealth.com, and we plan to issue the PO the week of 22 Sep (target).
- Net60 is preferable for Aurelia for the pilot, but we can accept the Net45 + swingline if the swingline is guaranteed for the first two invoices and the activation process is quick. We're trying to avoid a deposit that reduces usable cash for the pilot.
- VAT: we'll send our VAT registration and a short note from our tax counsel about reverse charge. If Redwood can attach the supporting evidence to the invoice, that should satisfy our audit team.

If you can send a one‑page addendum and a DocuSign link today or tomorrow, I can get our legal and AP teams to sign quickly. Also please include the timeline for how the corridor can expand (your point 3).

Thanks — Marcus
[attachment: None]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for pilot — Aurelia / Redwood

Marcus — thanks, that timeline works. Next steps from Redwood:

1) I'll have Sales Ops generate a one‑page addendum reflecting: Net45 baseline, 30‑day swingline to Net60 up to $75k, automatic review and potential corridor increase to $150k after month‑2 consumption triggers (subject to AP verification + simple credit check), and the consumption cap language Vivek suggested.
2) Legal will add the VAT reimbursement clause you agreed to and a requirement that you provide VAT registration and counsel note for reverse charge handling.
3) DocuSign link will be shared by EOD PST — please have AP sign and upload PO in the HubSpot deal (link below). Once signed, Sales Ops will enable the swingline provisioning and mark the first two invoices as eligible.

I'll copy Marissa (revenue leader) for awareness and ask Sales Ops to include a short credit workbook so you can see trigger points. If anything changes on your end re: PO timing, please let me know.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-invoice-template.pdf (pdf)]
